# Code of Conduct

This project follows a simple standard: be respectful, constructive, and generous with context.

## Expected Behavior

- Be welcoming and professional.
- Give actionable feedback without hostility.
- Assume good intent while still being clear about problems.
- Focus on improving the work, not scoring points.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, intimidation, or discriminatory language
- Personal attacks or bad-faith trolling
- Publishing private information without permission

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, or block contributors whose behavior harms the community.

Questions or concerns can be raised through [https://x.com/milonspace](https://x.com/milonspace).
